name: 狂信者献祭
description: 本棋子受到4点真实伤害。若血誓诅咒已生效，对被诅咒目标造成4点真实伤害，再造成等同于本棋子已损失生命值1/3的真实伤害。
code: function executeSkill(context) { var caster = context.piece; var maxHp = caster.maxHp || (caster.stats && caster.stats.maxHp) || 18; var lostHp = maxHp - caster.currentHp; var result = dealDamage(caster, caster, 4, 'true', context.battle, context.skill.id); var oathed = context.battle.pieces.find(function(p) { return p.ownerPlayerId !== caster.ownerPlayerId && p.currentHp > 0 && p.statusTags && p.statusTags.some(function(t) { return t.type === 'blood-oath'; }); }); var bonusDamage = Math.floor(lostHp / 3); if (oathed && bonusDamage > 0) { dealDamage(caster, oathed, bonusDamage, 'true', context.battle, 'sacrifice-bonus'); return { success: true, message: caster.name + '发动狂信者献祭，对自身造成' + result.damage + '点真实伤害，对' + oathed.name + '造成' + (4 + bonusDamage) + '点真实伤害（含' + bonusDamage + '点苦难加深）' }; } return { success: true, message: caster.name + '发动狂信者献祭，对自身造成' + result.damage + '点真实伤害' }; }
previewCode: function calculatePreview(piece, skillDef) { var maxHp = piece.maxHp || (piece.stats && piece.stats.maxHp) || 18; var lostHp = maxHp - piece.currentHp; var bonus = Math.floor(lostHp / 3); return { description: "本棋子受到4点真实伤害。若血誓诅咒已生效，对被诅咒目标造成4点真实伤害，再造成等同于本棋子已损失生命值1/3的真实伤害。", expectedValues: { selfDamage: 4, reflectedDamage: 4, bonusDamage: bonus } }; }
